description: Create or update a file on a branch via git plumbing. Wraps `createOrUpdateFileOnBranch`. Pass `content` as a UTF-8 string OR `content_base64` for binary. Meets the same branch protection, rulesets and secret scan as a git push, and fires CI/webhooks like one. Requires 'repo' scope.

expect_blob_sha.description: Optimistic-concurrency check: existing blob sha must match.

name: gluecron_write_file
